traits.note: Abrams's flora (vol. 1, 1923): a stemless swamp herb from a thick, horizontal rootstock; the spathe sheathes at its foot and opens above into a broad coloured blade; the spadix, at first inside it, is later held well out on a stout peduncle; flowers bisexual, crowded over the cylindrical spadix, each with a four-lobed perianth and four stamens opposite the lobes.
